title: Closing words: the moment in music is priceless
summary: In closing Hodes tells of a pianist who saved and lost everything. He says music is priceless and he regrets nothing.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: -- may I say this in closing? I met a pianist who worked during the same years that I did, in bars and clubs. And he read the specs and he played the floor show, and he saved his money and he lost his eyesight and he lost all his money in the Crash.

And what did he have to show for it? Because it wasn't enjoyable, it was a job that he went to work to get. And how many people do you read about that work so that they can retire and then drop dead a year later, after they've built that house? They have failed to live today, and this is what jazz music has given us. This they can't take away.

And how can anybody put a price on it? What you get out of music is priceless. So when you say, would you have done it, I would have done it sooner and quicker and more avidly. I'd have put more of my life into it, if I could, so I could have gotten more of it. No question about it. I don't regret a dime I lost or the meals I missed. So what? Big deal. I ate at the House of Parliament, big deal, big deal.

The meaningful things in life to me are the real things. I do not stand in front of a French painting and say, isn't that wonderful, when I don't understand it. I look at it and say, I don't understand it. But I do understand that bowl

of cherries, I do understand the vase. This I understand. Now, if that's ignorance on my part, I admit ignorance. But I'm alive watching this. If I'm ignorant of all these scales and exercises, you guys are cutting up on the piano. I'm sorry, I'm ignorant. You ain't said nothing to me except that you've gone to school much more than I ever did. You learned a lot more about the instrument than I have learned. But you forgot one thing, you forgot where the sure-enough is.
